name: Memory support cases
intended_population: Proposed memories with their original source messages. Synthetic examples for one public lesson. No real conversation.
sampling_method: Written for this example to cover one pass, one fail, and one review case. No sampling of any real population.
label_guidelines: Supported: the original sources establish every material claim. Contradicted: one claim conflicts with one explicit statement in the sources. Insufficient: no conflict exists and the sources cannot establish one claim.
